query: What are the criteria for qualifying an enterprise customer?
expectedAnswerElements: minimum annual recurring contract value of $25,000
groundedSample: Enterprise qualification requires a verified organization tax ID, active corporate email domain, and minimum annual contract value of $25,000 [S1].
ungroundedClaimSample: Enterprise qualification guarantees a 90-day free pilot for all fortune 500 companies [S1].

query: When is compliance approval required for customer workflows?
groundedSample: Accounts flagged under Tier-3 risk require manual compliance approval by a Senior Risk Officer before automated task execution can proceed [S2].
fabricatedCitationSample: Tier-3 accounts are automatically approved by AI [S4].
ungroundedClaimSample: Compliance approval can be bypassed by standard developers on weekends.

query: What governance governs outbound customer emails?
groundedSample: Outbound emails involving customer data must be staged as drafts and require explicit human-in-the-loop approval before transmission [S3].
fabricatedCitationSample: Emails are sent automatically by the worker daemon without human review [S1].
ungroundedClaimSample: Emails can be sent directly to external recipients without draft staging.
